walkthroughs.body_html:
Resource Reliance — a core area of GCSE Geography.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Resource Reliance brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Resource Reliance.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why is ocean acidification a separate threat from ocean warming?
options: Acidification occurs because oceans absorb atmospheric CO2, forming carbonic acid and lowering pH — this dissolves calcium carbonate shells and corals, independent of any warming.
A corrie forms when a river dries up high in the mountains.
Ocean acidification is caused by acid rain falling on the sea.
Ocean acidification is just another name for ocean warming.
A corrie is just a small lake at the top of a mountain.
A corrie forms when a river dries up high in the mountains.
Managed retreat means letting all coastal towns disappear into the sea.

Snow accumulates in a north-east-facing hollow, compacts to ice, and rotational movement combined with plucking and abrasion deepens the hollow into an armchair shape; meltwater can fill it as a tarn.
